title: Global cost
description: USD per hour across every cluster that sends to this management cluster (ADR-0011), from each cluster's OpenCost.

panels.title: Cost per namespace
panels.description: CPU, memory and GPU allocation cost per namespace and cluster.

targets.expr: sum by (cloud, cluster, namespace) (label_replace(avg by (cloud, cluster, container, node, namespace, pod) (container_cpu_allocation) * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left () avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_cpu_hourly_cost), "type", "cpu", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (cloud, cluster, container, node, namespace, pod) (container_memory_allocation_bytes) / 1073741824 * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left () avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_ram_hourly_cost), "type", "ram", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (cloud, cluster, container, node, namespace, pod) (container_gpu_allocation) * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left () avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_gpu_hourly_cost), "type", "gpu", "", ""))

panels.title: Cost per model
panels.description: Allocation cost of each model server, per cluster.

targets.expr: sum by (cloud, cluster, model) (label_replace(label_replace(avg by (cloud, cluster, container, node, namespace, pod) (container_cpu_allocation{namespace="models"}) * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left () avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_cpu_hourly_cost), "type", "cpu", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (cloud, cluster, container, node, namespace, pod) (container_memory_allocation_bytes{namespace="models"}) / 1073741824 * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left () avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_ram_hourly_cost), "type", "ram", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (cloud, cluster, container, node, namespace, pod) (container_gpu_allocation{namespace="models"}) * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left () avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_gpu_hourly_cost), "type", "gpu", "", ""), "model", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"))

panels.title: Cost per GPU type
panels.description: Whole-node cost of GPU and Neuron nodes per Karpenter node pool, per cluster.

targets.expr: sum by (cloud, cluster, nodepool) (avg by (cloud, cluster, node) (node_total_hourly_cost) * on (cloud, cluster, node) group_left (nodepool) label_replace(max by (cloud, cluster, node_name, nodepool) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{resource_type=~"nvidia.com/gpu|aws.amazon.com/neuron"} > 0), "node", "$1", "node_name", "(.*)"))
